# Meet Me in Dia
“Can we huddle quick?” “Just confirming you’re joining!” “You’re on mute.”
In a day of back‑to‑backs, or even just browsing, Dia helps you stay on time and stay prepared. With our latest release, everything feels smoother—whether you're switching tabs, presenting key metrics, or decoding acronyms.
Every tab on Dia has support built in, from previewing your meeting invite to providing the link for your next call.

...

A refreshed Find in Page
**Find in Page** gets a visual polish to match Dia’s new design. Press CMD + F to open.
shipped by
Charlie
Keep your Tabs alive
Dia now automatically reloads select recent background tabs, based on your device and tab activity. Tab discarding respects app active time—so tabs won't go blank while you’re away.
shipped by
Seb
